name: Blight Druid
summary: A keeper of corrupted and ruined lands who bonds with decay, sickens nearby life, and spreads supernatural disease.

featureOverrides.summary: Influence vermin normally and influence animals or formerly-animal mindless undead at -4 unless they carry disease.

features.name: Blighted Nature Bond
features.summary: Choose a Wizard-style familiar or a permitted nature, Darkness, Death, or Destruction domain.

features.name: Blight Familiar
features.summary: If Familiar was chosen for Blighted Nature Bond, choose its form.
features.requiredOptionMessage: Choose the Familiar nature bond first

features.name: Miasma
features.summary: Adjacent creatures must save each turn or become sickened; animals, fey, and plants are instead nauseated and then sickened.

features.name: Blightblooded
features.summary: Become immune to natural and supernatural disease and to the sickened and nauseated conditions.

features.name: Plaguebearer
features.summary: Creatures striking you with touch attacks, unarmed strikes, or natural weapons risk contracting contagion.
